name: @omadia/sandbox
description: Durable per-scope agent sandbox (issue #576, qm competitive analysis). Narrow Sandbox contract (provision/run/read/write/list/teardown) with optional capabilities behind type guards, AgentComputerProfile (persistence/egress/process declarations), and a local-Docker backend with an injectable exec seam for hermetic tests. Backends are interchangeable so a Fly/Firecracker/Satellite (#746) backend can implement the same contract later.
